faqs.question: What is the difference between /model/nanobana and /model/nanobanana-2?
faqs.answer: Nano Banana 2 is framed here as the more production-oriented sibling: better for heavier reference-driven edits, stronger output controls, and premium concept generation with clearer layout intent.

faqs.question: Does Nano Banana 2 still use the same creator workbench?
faqs.answer: Yes. The left form flow and the right media panel are still reused from creator, so the page changes the model context without changing the core creation workflow.

faqs.question: Why make a separate model page for Nano Banana 2?
faqs.answer: Because the user intent is different. This page helps position Nano Banana 2 as an upgrade path and lets you explain its best-fit scenarios without mixing it into a generic tools page.
